body:
Self-contained specification for PreToolUse read-only schemas, Go fold.go key parity, and 4-root `boosterDataRoots`:

1. `hooks/policy/paths.mjs`:
   - Expand `boosterDataRoots(home)` to return all 4 canonical plugin-data roots under `home`: `join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity-cli', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster')`, `join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster')`, `join(home, '.gemini', 'antigravity-ide', 'plugin_data', 'antigravity-booster')`, and `join(home, '.config', 'antigravity-booster')`.

2. `hooks/policy/constants.mjs`:
   - Add `'list_dir'`, `'list_permissions'`, `'search_in_file'`, `'wait'`, and `'wait_5_seconds'` to `READ_ONLY_TOOLS` (retaining all existing legacy names).
   - Add the exact arrays to `READ_TOOL_PATH_SCHEMAS`: `list_dir: ['DirectoryPath', 'DirAbsolutePath', 'AbsolutePath', 'path', 'dir']`, `list_permissions: ['paths', 'path']`, and `search_in_file: ['paths', 'path', 'DirectoryPath', 'SearchPath']`.
   - Export `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS` mapping the 10 required-path read tools to their folded lowercase key arrays:
     - `view_file` & `view_file_outline`: `['absolutepath', 'filepath', 'path']`
     - `read_file`: `['path', 'absolutepath', 'filepath']`
     - `read_notebook`: `['notebookpath', 'absolutepath', 'path']`
     - `read_browser_page` & `read_url_content`: `['url']`
     - `list_dir` & `list_directory`: `['directorypath', 'dirabsolutepath', 'absolutepath', 'path', 'dir']`
     - `list_permissions`: `['paths', 'path']`
     - `search_in_file`: `['paths', 'path', 'directorypath', 'searchpath']`.

3. `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs`:
   - Export `goFoldKey(k)` = `String(k).replace(/\u017f/g, 's').replace(/\u212a/g, 'k').toLowerCase()`.
   - Export `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args)`:
     (a) Reject non-plain objects (`args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)`) with `{ ok: false, reason: 'Tool arguments must be a plain JSON object' }`.
     (b) Enforce pure printable-ASCII key gate first: every key `k` in `Object.keys(args)` must match `/^[\x20-\x7E]+$/`; any non-ASCII rune (including `U+017F` `'ſ'` and `U+212A` `'K'`) or control byte returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'Non-ASCII or control character in tool argument key' }`.
     (c) Fold keys via `goFoldKey(k)`; if any two keys collide under `goFoldKey`, return `{ ok: false, reason: 'Duplicate case-folded argument key' }`. Otherwise return `{ ok: true, folded, raw: args }` where `folded` uses `Object.create(null)`.
   - In `evaluatePayload`, pass `const args = payload.toolCall.args === undefined ? {} : payload.toolCall.args;` so explicit `null` or `Array` args reach `stepOne` and get denied by `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive`! Enforce `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args)` at the top of `stepOne(name, args, ctx)` and in `extractProbedPaths` (supporting case-folded required/altRequired lookup on `TOOL_PATH_SCHEMAS`).
   - Export `extractReadToolPaths(name, rawArgs)` and wire into `stepOne` (reusing existing `toPath(value)` at `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs:43`):
     - When `Object.hasOwn(REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS, name)`:
       1. Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)` (`!norm.ok` -> return `{ ok: false, reason: norm.reason }`).
       2. Iterate over **all** keys `k` in `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS[name]` where `norm.folded[k] !== undefined`, collecting every extracted string into `extractedPaths` (never stopping at the first match): for `k === 'paths'`, accept either a single non-empty trimmed `string` or a non-empty `Array` of non-empty trimmed `string`s (flattened in order into `extractedPaths`); for any other key `k` in `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS[name]`, require a non-empty trimmed `string`. Any invalid type or empty string/array on any present path key returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'Invalid read-tool path parameter' }`.
       3. Require `extractedPaths.length >= 1` (`0` -> return `{ ok: false, reason: 'Missing required read-tool path parameter' }`).
       4. Non-path string keys `{ toolaction, toolsummary }` (plus `pattern` and `query` on `search_in_file` and `pageid` on `read_browser_page`) must have `typeof val === 'string'` when present; any other present key outside `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS[name]` is allowed ONLY if `typeof val === 'boolean' || (typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val))`; any other key with `string`, `Array`, `Object`, `null`, or non-finite number returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'Unexpected non-scalar or unapproved string argument on read tool' }`.
       5. Return `{ ok: true, paths: extractedPaths.map(toPath) }`. In `stepOne`, if `!readRes.ok` return `deny(readRes.reason)`; otherwise set `candidates = [...readRes.paths, ...scanPathLike(rawArgs).paths]` and pass through the existing `stepOne` loop at lines 362–374 (`if (matchRoot(r, ctx.boosterDataRoots, ctx.platform)) return deny('Inspection or modification of booster plugin data or credentials via tool calls is forbidden');`).
     - Keep non-required-path `READ_ONLY_TOOLS` (`grep_search`, `code_search`, `file_search`, `find_by_name`, `read_resource`, `search_web`, `list_resources`, `ask_question`, `read_terminal`, `command_status`, `wait`, `wait_5_seconds`) passing when called without path args (preserving `test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs:103-105`), while still checking present path keys and `scanPathLike` against `boosterDataRoots`.

4. Build & Targeted Tests:
   - Write `test/policy-1-5-9-readonly.test.mjs` covering all 10 `REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS` tools across all 5 context columns (`1`: `env: { AGB_WORKER_MODE: 'readonly' }`, `2`: `env: { AGB_WORKER_TICKET: 't-1' }`, `3`: interactive ADLC workspace with active rails, `4`: interactive ADLC workspace without active rails, `5`: interactive non-ADLC plain directory), multi-key collection + `paths` array flattening, non-ASCII `ſ`/`K` & case-duplicate rejection, `{"AbsolutePath": true, "path": "safe"}` type confusion denial, and all 4 `boosterDataRoots` canonical roots (`{ decision: 'deny', reason: 'Inspection or modification of booster plugin data or credentials via tool calls is forbidden' }`).
   - Run `npm run build && node --test test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs test/policy-1-5-9-readonly.test.mjs` (keep `dist/**` rebuilt; the scheduler runs full `npm test` automatically after your turn).

edges.contract: T1 exports goFoldKey(k), normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args), and extractReadToolPaths(name, args) from hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs, exports REQUIRED_READ_PATH_KEYS and promotes list_dir/list_permissions/search_in_file/wait/wait_5_seconds in hooks/policy/constants.mjs, and expands boosterDataRoots(home) to all 4 plugin-data roots in hooks/policy/paths.mjs. T2 reuses normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive and evaluateFileTool without editing test/policy-1-5-9-readonly.test.mjs.

title: Harden PreToolUse read-only schemas, Go fold.go key parity, and 4-root boosterDataRoots
